multimodal.title: Document intake
multimodal.description: Let an agent read uploaded or emailed documents (PDFs, receipts, spreadsheets) and fill these flows' inputs, with the extracted fields shown to a person before any write.

multimodal.title: Image understanding
multimodal.description: Let an agent inspect images (photos, scans, ID documents) to classify or extract details before these flows run.

phases.name: Phase 1: Read-only tools
phases.summary: Expose 17 read-only tool(s) through `legacy2mcp generate`. Agents can look things up but change nothing; every call is schema-validated and audit-logged.
prerequisites: Review each tool's description and input schema in the report
Point the generated config at a staging base URL
exit_criteria: Agents answer real questions using only these tools
Audit log reviewed for a week with no surprises

phases.name: Phase 2: Low-risk writes with approval
phases.summary: Add 11 low-risk write tool(s) with `allow_write_operations: true`, each behind a policy approval and rate limits.
prerequisites: Decide the approval policy (who approves, which writes are auto-approved)
Add authentication to 1 write flow(s) that showed none
exit_criteria: Every write is attributable to an approver in the audit log
Rollback path tested for each write tool

phases.name: Phase 3: Agent orchestration
phases.summary: Run a coordinator with 4 specialist agent(s); add 7 high-risk tool(s) (HTTP DELETE endpoint; changes credentials or issues tokens; sends data to an external service) behind human approval on every call, and 2 multimodal intake path(s).
prerequisites: Human-approval UI or chat step wired to the coordinator
Spending/deletion limits agreed with the business owner
Incident runbook for a bad agent action
exit_criteria: High-risk calls happen only after a recorded human approval
End-to-end flows succeed on staging data
